name: JwtVerify
description: Verifies a signed JWT and returns the claims. Validates signature, expiration, not-before, issuer, and audience.
syntax: JwtVerify( string token, any key, [any algorithms], [string issuer], [string audience], [numeric clockSkew], [boolean throwOnError] )

params.name: key
params.description: Verification key. For HMAC: string or byte array. For RSA/EC: PEM string or Java PublicKey object.

params.name: algorithms
params.description: Allowed algorithms. Array or comma-separated string. Security best practice to restrict algorithms.

params.name: issuer
params.description: Required issuer (iss claim). Validation fails if token issuer doesn't match.

params.name: audience
params.description: Required audience (aud claim). Validation fails if audience is not in token's audience list.

params.name: clockSkew
params.description: Clock skew tolerance in seconds for exp/nbf validation. Default 0.

params.name: throwOnError
params.description: If true (default), throws on invalid token. If false, returns struct with valid, claims, error. Note: defaults to true unlike hash verify functions, since JWT validation failures typically indicate a security issue.
